## Welcome to the Foret Lab

The Foret Lab is an academic research group dedicated to understanding complex
natural systems through rigorous, data-driven science. We combine fieldwork,
computational modeling, and open collaboration to address pressing questions in
ecology and environmental science.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

### Research

We pursue open, reproducible research spanning ecology, environmental data
science, and computational modeling.

[See our projects →](projects.qmd)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

### People

Our lab brings together students, postdocs, and faculty from diverse
backgrounds.

[Meet the team →](members.qmd)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

### Mission

We are committed to scientific integrity, mentorship, and sharing our work with
the broader community.
